Dear Dr. Mercer,

Thank you for seeing this 29-year-old accountant for clinical evaluation. He takes no daily medications, has no known medical conditions, and remains in good general health.

On physical examination, he displays disproportionate excessive height characterized by elongated limbs relative to his trunk, paired with bilateral flat feet and a reducible groin herniation. Craniofacial inspection reveals an elongated scaphocephalic cranial shape, a prominent bulging forehead, widely spaced eyes, and a distinctly projecting nasal bridge. His jaw is well formed without chin recession, midface contour is preserved, and his ears are normally placed without epicanthic folds. Intraoral inspection shows a vaulted roof of the mouth, though the palate is fully intact without clefting and his uvula is undivided.

Visual assessment shows white sclerae without a bluish hue, no nearsightedness, normal ocular alignment without squint, and standard corneal contours lacking conical ectasia. His skin is notably transparent with visible superficial veins, alongside multiple tiny benign epidermal inclusion cysts on the cheeks. However, his skin demonstrates normal recoil without cutaneous hyperstretchability, stretch marks, papyraceous scars, spontaneous bruising, or self-resolving squamous neoplasms.

His spine is straight without lateral deviation, and cervical spine stability is intact. His chest wall shows neither sternal depression nor pigeon-breast protrusion. The extremities demonstrate no knock-knees, clubfoot deformity, spider-like finger elongation, arthritic wear, contractures, or joint hyperlaxity, and he denies recurrent dislocations.

His urethral meatus is normally located. Prior imaging and tests excluded dural sac widening, bowel twisting, tortuous arterial paths, and venous varicosities. Transthoracic echocardiography showed no persistent arterial duct, mitral leaflet billowing, or regurgitant flow across the mitral valve, and he has no history of spontaneous coronary tears or dietary allergies.

I would appreciate your expert opinion regarding his overall assessment.

Sincerely,
Dr. Clara Bailey
